name: Antoine Dubois
bio:
Antoine's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics, at École Centrale Paris. After graduating, he joined a small GT racing team, where he honed his skills in vehicle dynamics and data analysis. His meticulous approach and problem-solving abilities quickly earned him a reputation as a rising star.

Prior to joining Rexal FMI Racing, Antoine spent several years as a performance engineer, focusing on improving car setup and tire management. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and other engineers. He believes in a collaborative approach, fostering open communication and teamwork within the engineering department. Antoine is driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance through innovative solutions and data-driven decisions. He is detail-oriented, and never stops learning.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Antoine is of average height, with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.
